verdict.rationale: Mercury documents its own receipt matching: users email or upload receipts and Mercury auto-attaches them to the right card transaction (mercury-docs-5, mercury-docs-28). It also offers AI-powered accounting-sync automations, category and attachment API endpoints, and an official receipt-upload agent skill (mercury-docs-6, mercury-docs-12, mercury-docs-29, mercury-supp-agent-skills). However, the user still has to forward or upload each receipt, so nothing is captured automatically at the moment the card is used. Automatic coding of card transactions is only implied, not documented. Missing for 10: capture triggered by the card swipe itself without user upload, explicit documentation of automatic categorization/GL coding of card spend, independent or hands-on corroboration.
